content.title: Arizona basketball routs Long Island in March Madness first-round game
content.text: Updated March 20, 2026, 12:54 p.m. MTThe No. 1 seed Arizona Wildcats opened their NCAA Tournament run in dominating fashion on Friday, March 20, routing No. 16 seed Long Island in the first round of March Madness in San Diego, California.What was the final score of the Arizona vs LIU game?Who stood out?What were some key stats?Look back out our live updates from the game, which was played at Viejas Arena to see how the March Madness opener went down for Tommy Lloyd's team.Watch Arizona vs Long Island on Sling What was the Arizona basketball vs Long Island score?The Arizona Wildcats defeated the Long Island Sharks in March Madness on Friday, May 20, 2026, 92-58. Arizona Wildcats rout Long Island Sharks in March Madness openerThe Arizona Wildcats, the No. 1 seed in the West Region, cruised to a 92-58 win over Long Island in the first round of the NCAA Tournament on Friday, March 20, behind a great shooting effort against the Sharks.Arizona will face either No. 8 Villanova or No. 9 Utah State in the second round on Sunday, March 22.Braydon Burries led Arizona with 18 points in the Wildcats' win. Arizona led by as many as 38 points.The Wildcats built a 53-29 lead at the half and never looked back against Long Island. Arizona shot 53% from the field in the game and 46% from 3.It had 52 rebounds, compared to 31 for LIU.Arizona moved to 33-2 on the season. Long Island ended the year with a 24-11 record.It is Arizona's largest margin of victory in an NCAA Tournament game since 1998.Final score: Arizona 92, Long Island 58 Arizona Wildcats in control late vs Long IslandThe Arizona basketball team has built an 82-49 lead over Long Island with 3:37 left in the first round of the NCAA Tournament.Arizona has had its share of NCAA Tournament disappointments, but not in this game. The Wildcats came out ready for the Sharks and have controlled this game.Arizona is about to move to 33-2 on the season.Score: Arizona 84, Long Island 49 (3:37 left in second half) Arizona extends lead vs Long Island in second half of NCAA TournamentThe Wildcats have their lead back up to 31 points against the Sharks in the second half, as they get closer to advancing to the second round.Four Arizona players are now in double figures, with Brayden Burries at 18, Koa Peat at 13, Ivan Kharchenkov at 12 and Tobe Awaka with 11 points off the bench.Arizona is dominating on the glass, with a 44-23 rebounding advantage.There's a lot to like about this performance for No. 1 seed Arizona.Score: Arizona 76, Long Island 45 (6:46 left in second half) Long Island playing with effort vs Arizona in March MadnessLet's give the Sharks some credit. They are outmatched against Arizona, but they are not being out-efforted.Long Island has pulled within 24 after being down by 32 against the Wildcats, going on a mini-run after Arizona scored the first eight points of the half.Tommy Lloyd went with a smaller lineup and Long Island took advantage of it before a break in the action.Still, Arizona is up by 24 points and in control of this game.Score: Arizona 67, Long Island 43 (11:24 left in second half) Arizona starts second half with another run vs Long IslandArizona scored the first eight points of the second half to build a 61-29 lead, its largest lead of the game.Long Island answered with five straight.The Wildcats are still shooting over 60% from the field and are at 60% from 3-point range.LIU is now shooting 32% from the field and 38% from 3.Arizona has 14 assists on 22 made field goals in this game.Score: Arizona 61, Long Island 34 (15:55 left in second half) Arizona takes big lead into half against Long IslandThey have played 20 minutes in San Diego and it's been all Arizona against Long Island.The Wildcats have a 53-29 lead at the half thanks to an impressive shooting performance.Arizona is 19-for-33 from the field and 6-for-10 from 3-point range in this game. It has 27 rebounds and 10 offensive rebounds in this game.It is 9-for-15 from the free-throw line.LIU is 12-for-34 from the field and 5-for-11 from 3-point range. It has 13 rebounds. It did not attempt a free throw in the first half.Brayden Burries led the Wildcats with 14 points in the first half. Mason Porter-Brown paced Long Island with nine.Halftime score: Arizona 53, Long Island 29 Arizona flexing vs Long Island in NCAA TournamentMake that a 27-point lead for Arizona over Long Island.The Wildcats are on an 18-2 run against the Sharks, sparked by Brayden Burries' 14 points.Burries is 4-for-5 from 3-point range, including knocking down a long 3-pointer as part of Arizona's impressive run.The Wildcats have 24 rebounds in the first half, including nine offensive boards. The Sharks have 11.Arizona is certainly playing the part of one of the March Madness favorites early.Score: Arizona 47, Long Island 20 (3:45 left in first half) Arizona building lead vs Long Island in first halfLong Island has switched to a zone to try to contain Arizona late in the first half.It hasn't worked.The Wildcats have extended their lead to 20 points with some great passing to find the open man and beat the zone.Arizona is shooting 64% from the field and 71% from 3-point range. Pretty had for a 16-seed to have a chance when the No. 1 seed is shooting that well.Score: Arizona 40, Long Island 20 (6:00 left in first half) Long Island called for flagrant foul vs ArizonaLong Island didn't help its upset cause with a flagrant foul by Xinyi Li in the first half.Li just pushed Arizona's Montiejus Krivas out of the way while they were running down the court, with Krivas ending up on the floor.Arizona was able to extend its lead to 16 at the next break, partly because of the flagrant foul.Arizona has outscored LIU in the paint in this game, 16-4.Score: Arizona 34, Long Island 18 (7:43 left in first half) Mason Porter-Brown steps up for Long Island vs ArizonaWe now have a tie for the highest scorer in this game.Mason Porter-Brown is keeping Long Island in this game against Arizona with his hustle and shooting.He now has nine points in the game on 3-for-6 shooting. He is 3-for-4 from 3-point range.And he has done it as Long Island's 6th man, playing 17 minutes off the bench.Score: Arizona 29, Long Island 19 (9:34 left in first half) Arizona distributing ball early vs Long Islandit's amazing what you can do when you pass the ball.Arizona has seven early assists on nine field goals against Long Island.Brayden Burries leads the team with two of them. The freshman is off to an impressive start in his first NCAA Tournament game, with nine points to lead all scorers.He is 3-for-3 on field goal attempts, all 3-pointers.Arizona is now leading by 12. Six Wildcats have scored.Score: Arizona 24, Long Island 12 (11:52 left in first half) Arizona hot from 3-point range early vs Long Island in NCAA TournamentThe Arizona Wildcats are not known as a good shooting 3-point team.You wouldn't know it from early in the first-round NCAA Tournament game against Long Island.Arizona is 3-for-4 from 3-point range against the Sharks, which has helped it build an early 15-4 lead.Long Island is 0-for-1 from 3 and 2-for-8 from the field.Score: Arizona 15, Long Island 4 (15:19 left in first half) Arizona off to fast start vs Long Island in March Madness openerWill the Arizona basketball team get a scare early in its March Madness opener, like Duke?It doesn't appear so.At the first break in action in San Diego, California, the No. 1 Wildcats have run out to a 12-2 lead on the No. 16 Long Island Sharks.Arizona has earned some good looks in transition. It is 5-for-6 from the field and 2-for-2 from 3-point range.Jaden Bradley leads the Wildcats with five early points.Score: Arizona 12, Long Island 2 (16:59 left in first half) How to watch Arizona basketball vs Long Island in March Madness in ArizonaThe game between Long Island and Arizona is scheduled to begin at 10:35 a.m. MST (1:35 p.m. Eastern time) and can be seen on TNT.It can be streamed on Sling TV.Kevin Harlan, Robbie Hummel, Stan Van Gundy and Lauren Shehadi are scheduled to be the announcing team for the game.How to watch March Madness: Kentucky-Santa Clara | Texas Tech-Akron | Arizona-Long Island | Virginia-Wright State | Iowa State-Tennessee State | Alabama-Hofstra | Villanova-Utah State | Clemson-Iowa | St. John's-UNI | UCLA-UCF | Purdue-Queens | Kansas-Cal Baptist | UConn-Furman | Miami-Missouri | Schedule | TV channels | Announcers How Arizona got into NCAA TournamentArizona advanced to the NCAA Tournament by winning the Big 12 Tournament. What to know about Long Island SharksThe Sharks are led in scoring by Jamal Fuller, who averages 16.4 points per game, and Malachi Davis, who averages 14.4 points per game.Long Island has made 36.1% of its 3-point attempts on the season. This Wildcats team seems poised for a very long run, however.Score prediction: Arizona 92.
